narration: You were $7 short of free shipping and threw one more item in the cart. Feels smart, right? This habit is quietly draining $890 from your wallet every single year.
visual: Dark background. SVG shopping cart with items inside. Amber 'ADD $7 MORE FOR FREE DELIVERY' badge springs into view. Progress bar crawling toward the $35 threshold.

narration: Free shipping minimums weren't designed to help you. Amazon actually patented threshold incentives to trigger that exact add-to-cart reflex — and every major retailer copied it.
visual: Light background. Three-step flow diagram: amber badge lure → brain icon (loss aversion) → shopping bag with dollar sign. Arrows between each step spring in with text 'ENGINEERED BY DESIGN'.

narration: Here's the math nobody does. You spend $7 to unlock free shipping worth $5.99. That's a dollar lost on something you never planned to buy in the first place.
visual: Dark background. Two vertical bars side by side: left bar '$5.99 SHIPPING' shorter in green, right bar '$7.00 ITEM' taller in red. Arrow pointing to difference: '$1.01 WASTED' in amber.

narration: Now scale it up. Americans average 276 online orders a year — and every single one has that same threshold trap waiting to drain your wallet a few dollars at a time.
visual: Light background. Grid of 24 shopping bag SVG icons (6 columns × 4 rows) representing monthly orders. Counter at bottom animates up to 276. Text: '23 ORDERS/MONTH × 12'.

narration: Add just $3.22 extra per order and you've spent $890 more than you planned — to avoid $168 in shipping fees. That's a $722 net loss every year. Wild, right?
visual: Dark background. Large '$890' counter animates from $0 upward with spring effect. Below it two comparison bars: '$168 shipping avoided' (small) vs '$890 extra spent' (large, in red). '$722 NET LOSS' label.

narration: Next time you're a few bucks short of free delivery, just pay the shipping fee — it's almost always cheaper than the item you'd throw in the cart. Follow for more of this.
visual: Light background. Person silhouette holding phone. Two choice buttons: 'ADD ITEM' crossed out in red, 'PAY $5.99 SHIPPING' with green checkmark. Piggy bank SVG grows in size as savings accumulate.
